## Pull Request Guidelines

**Before submitting:** Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for full guidelines.

**Monthly Review Cycle:** PRs reviewed on the 1st of each month. No guaranteed response time or merge.

---

## Type of Change

<!-- Check the type that applies to this PR -->

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (fixes a specific issue)
- [ ] 🔒 Security fix (addresses a vulnerability)
- [ ] 📖 Documentation improvement
- [ ] ✨ New feature (❌ not accepted - please fork instead)
- [ ] ⚡ Enhancement/optimization (❌ not accepted - please fork instead)

## Bug Fix Checklist

<!-- Required for bug fix PRs -->

- [ ] Includes steps to reproduce the bug
- [ ] Includes test case or manual verification steps
- [ ] Updates documentation if needed
- [ ] Follows existing code style
- [ ] No breaking changes
- [ ] Build passes (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Linked to an existing issue

---

## Documentation Checklist

<!-- Required for documentation PRs -->

- [ ] Fixes incorrect information OR improves clarity OR adds missing info
- [ ] Follows existing documentation style
- [ ] No breaking changes to documented behavior

## For New Features or Enhancements

**This PR type is not accepted.** Please:

1. Fork this repository
2. Implement your feature in your fork
3. Share your fork with the community
4. Close this PR

The MIT License encourages independent forks!
